stage: Product material export only; separate from controlled diagnosis/repair costs.

exporter_failure.scope: An exporter provenance assertion assumed every managed file had an individual diagnosis protection entry.
exporter_failure.resolution: Check unchanged protected managed metadata plus exact file hashes and existing individual hashes; no source or framework behavior was changed.

measurement_boundary: Only recorded command/query times are reported; unknown developer effort is not estimated. Diagnosis costs and fixed evidence files remain unchanged.

temporary_source_cleanup.cause: The native main-project guard detected duplicate application/UI routes in the two offline restored source trees.
temporary_source_cleanup.resolution: After every file was verified inside its source.zip, remove only those two temporary analysis directories. Scope/exclusion rules and accepted source remain unchanged.
